programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but must keep the puppy hidden from Dave in 'Dog Days', then in 'Dragon Dad', Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest in 'Skater Girl', then in 'All Washed Up', Simon's robot Geizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines, but is he actually helping.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith to a baseball game in 'The C Team', then in 'Father Daughter Dance', The Chipettes each want Dave to be their date for the dance.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's game launch is disrupted by Jeanette's changes in 'The Return of Thornbergaupht', then in 'Squashed', Alvin ropes Dave into playing squash.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin talks Dave into a poor scheme in 'Tour Bus', then in 'Game Show', Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him in 'Brittany the Body Snatcher', and in 'Agent Smith', to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story ever seen.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette signs The Chipmunks and Chipettes up for a competition in 'Going Green', then in 'Tattle Tail', Alvin likes a girl at school so he agrees to look after her talking bird.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff in 'Lost in Space...Camp', then in 'Super Hot Chocolate', Theodore loses his sense of taste.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty in 'Suck Toad', then in 'Secret Admirer', Alvin believes that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play in 'The Curse of MacBeth', then in 'Zeela The Great', Simon's robot Geizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is hurt before a major school event in 'The Temp', and in 'Parent Trap', Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, so Alvin gets Dave's help, bringing heated competion.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real.
